description: List the business's QR codes. Every printed QR is a short link (lknd.to/<code>) whose destination can change without reprinting. role: menu (the menu QR — is_default marks the one export_qr_codes prints; extra ones are separate placements such as a window), table (one per table, opens that table's order page) or link (any other URL). Returns each code's url (what the QR encodes), where a scan goes now (destination), its all-time scans and whether it is retired (retired codes open the menu, and so do table codes while the business doesn't take orders).
name: list_qr_codes
title: List qr codes
